prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for choose_path changes (copy, layout, notification), home redesign, and sign_in copy due to having only single tests.
Finish new_screen (2 tests) and finish copy (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Sign_in hints (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Home new_flow was the only helpful kind of change with a winning test (interactive waiting room), though other new_flow tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign (2 tests) showed no clear effect or negative results, with no winning tests.
Predictions were overall overly optimistic and generally too high compared to noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Waiting room companion mini game flow: Adds an interactive pet feeding mini-game flow directly on the waiting screen while pet generation finishes. (why: Home wait median is 201s and mean is 2336s; interactive micro-games keep idle users actively engaged during background rendering.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom pet sound preview screen: Adds a dedicated pet sound selection screen where users can choose their companion's vocal personality before finalizing adoption. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pets feeling or looking wrong upon generation; previewing pet voices sets clearer expectations before adoption.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Choose path interactive storybook redesign: Redesigns the story and path selection flow into a cohesive story_scroll layout with animated visual cards. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users with an 8s median time; a narrative storybook layout increases immersion and context.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Existing account pet recovery sign in copy: Updates the sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that signing in restores existing pets and saved items. (why: 8 support emails cited missing pets after signing in again; clear messaging prevents duplicate accounts and lost save states.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop audio alert on pet ready: Plays a playful chime sound when the pet finishes rendering on the waiting screen. (why: Home mean time of 2336s shows users switch windows while waiting; audio cues immediately prompt background users to return.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen background activity status tips: Adds an automated tip carousel to the waiting screen detailing background setup steps and desktop pet behavior facts. (why: Mean home step duration (2336s) causes user anxiety over frozen loading states; continuous tips reassure users of active progress.)
6: [finish, layout] Desktop pet control summary layout: Switches home_intro layout to spotlight mode with explicit control cheat-sheet cards explaining desktop interactions. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after onboarding, and finish completion is 64.8%.)
7: [finish, hint] Desktop pet visibility hint on home intro: Adds a hint on the finish screen explaining how to bring the pet back to focus if hidden behind full-screen windows. (why: 3 support emails reported that pets did not show up on the desktop or the app wouldn't open after onboarding completed.)
